fields.description:
Author ADR 0106 defining **remote-anchored below-horizon HISTORY reclamation** whose PRIMARY lever
is **commit/tree collapse** (retired-event GC is a secondary companion, not the pack lever), and
promote docs/concurrency.md §I1 'permanent retention' (epic b306) from a follow-up note to an
implemented+cross-referenced model. This ADR is the causal-stability contract that unblocks S1-S3.
(ADR number 0106 — 0105 was taken by an unrelated ADR that landed on origin/main.)

Scope (docs-only): the horizon config key (default 30d, portable, no CI-provider dependency); the
remote-reachability computation (collapse checkpoint reachable from the sync remote's tickets ref
for >= N days); the stale-clone detection + FORCED remote-override protocol on reconnect (a clone
whose last convergence is older than N days overrides local with remote rather than reintroducing
pre-collapse history by rebase); the **C1-C5 causal-stability boundary at the commit/tree-rewrite
level**; SNAPSHOT authorship_ledger carriage AND enforce_since re-anchor (both applied) for
signature/authorship verifiability; the portable rewrite primitive and per-backend publish-swap;
and a proof that invariants I1-I9 still hold. State the accepted residual: a >N-day-drifted clone's
divergent local work is discarded. (Re-scoped 2026-08-29 from '.retired-only' to the
commit/tree-collapse lever - see epic comment 'Child-roster re-scope'.)

Note: ADR numbering is a bijection — the ADR file is paired with a `docs/adr/.numbers/0106` marker
and the generated `docs/adr/README.md` index, both DERIVED by `scripts/gen_adr_index.py` from
`docs/adr/*.md` and checked by `scripts/check_adr_numbers.py` + `gen_adr_index.py --check` in the CI
docs-gates action (`.github/actions/docs-gates/action.yml`), NOT in `make lint`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `docs/adr/0106-remote-anchored-history-reclamation.md` exists with the ADR shape (`# ADR 0106:`
  title, `- **Status:**`, `## Context`, `## Decision`, `## Consequences`).
- [x] The ADR defines the N-day horizon as a portable config key (default 30d, with a stated rationale)
  and NO single-CI-provider trigger (the `project.portability` criterion applies).
- [x] The ADR specifies remote-reachability (collapse checkpoint reachable from the sync remote tickets
  ref for >= N days) and the stale-clone FORCED remote-override protocol on reconnect.
- [x] The ADR states the C1-C5 causal-stability boundary at the commit/tree-rewrite level and how
  signature/authorship verifiability is preserved (SNAPSHOT authorship_ledger carriage AND enforce_since
  re-anchor, both applied).
- [x] The ADR names the history-rewrite primitive as core-git (`git fast-import` / `mktree`+`commit-tree`,
  NO third-party `git filter-repo`) and, per backend, the publish-swap: git-ref `--force-with-lease` CAS
  for git remotes, and an exclusive push-locked bundle-set replacement bypassing the `git-remote-s3`
  auto-doctor for the S3 backend — citing the auto-doctor never-discard-a-head resurrection hazard
  (ADR 0093 / `src/rebar/_store/s3_doctor.py`) and proving its bypass safe under C1-C5.
- [x] The ADR proves invariants I1-I9 hold under reclamation and names the accepted residual
  (a >N-day-drifted clone's divergent local work is discarded).
- [x] The ADR-number bijection artifacts are regenerated: `python scripts/gen_adr_index.py` creates the
  `docs/adr/.numbers/0106` marker (content = the ADR filename) and adds a 0106 entry to the generated
  `docs/adr/README.md` index; no ADR cross-reference dangles.
- [x] `docs/concurrency.md` §I1 is promoted from 'follow-up' to implemented and cross-references ADR 0106.

## Verification
- `grep -n '^# ADR 0106:' docs/adr/0106-remote-anchored-history-reclamation.md` and
  `grep -n '^## \(Context\|Decision\|Consequences\)' docs/adr/0106-remote-anchored-history-reclamation.md`
  confirm the ADR shape and title.
- `grep -nE 'I[1-9]' docs/adr/0106-remote-anchored-history-reclamation.md` (I1-I9 proof present),
  `grep -nE 'C1|C5' docs/adr/0106-remote-anchored-history-reclamation.md` (C1-C5 boundary present),
  `grep -n 'ADR 0093\|s3_doctor' docs/adr/0106-remote-anchored-history-reclamation.md` (S3 hazard cited),
  `grep -n 'force-with-lease' docs/adr/0106-remote-anchored-history-reclamation.md` (git-ref CAS named),
  `grep -n 'discard' docs/adr/0106-remote-anchored-history-reclamation.md` (accepted residual stated).
- `python scripts/gen_adr_index.py` then `python scripts/check_adr_numbers.py` and
  `python scripts/gen_adr_index.py --check` pass (marker `docs/adr/.numbers/0106` present, README
  regenerated, bijection intact).
- `grep -n 'ADR 0106\|implemented' docs/concurrency.md` confirms the §I1 promotion + cross-reference;
  `grep -n '0106' docs/adr/README.md` confirms the index entry.
- `make lint` passes (ruff/format only); `rebar review-plan unlikely-zealous-skua` re-run confirms the
  plan is admissible.  [VERIFIED: change 2400 MERGED to main, LLM-Review+1 & Verified+1; all greps pass.]
